newsitem.title: USA: Mobile Telecom sees strong FY97 second half.
newsitem.headline: Mobile Telecom sees strong FY97 second half.

text.p: Mobile Telecommunication Technologies Corp said Thursday it expected a strong performance in the fiscal 1997 second half, based in part on the scheduled April launch of its advanced nationwide narrowband PCS paging system.
"We look for a very strong second half of 1997," said John Stupka, the company's president and chief executive.
The new text messaging service provides users with a store and forward capability for messages. It also has a messages correction feature that eliminates garbled messages.
Stupka said the pricing for the new service would be around $30 per month.
In the first 15 months of its commercial service of narrowband PCS, MTel said it signed on almost 30,000 advanced messaging customers.
"We expect to add at least 200,000 advanced messaging users in 1997," Stupka said.
MTel said it signed reselling partner agreements with 20 major telecommunications firms in order to expand its distribution network.
The company said it also will offer all services through SkyTel, its internal distribution entity.
